jobs.description:
**Job Title:** DEVELOPER L4
  
**City:** Hyderabad
  
**State/Province:** Telangana
  
**Posting Start Date:** 8/29/26
  
**Wipro Limited (NYSE:** WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.
  
  

Role Purpose
  
  

The purpose of this role is to design, test and maintain software programs for operating systems or applications which needs to be deployed at a client end and ensure its meet 100% quality assurance parameters
  
  

͏
  
  

Do
  
  

1\. Instrumental in understanding the requirements and design of the product/ software
  
  

Develop software solutions by studying information needs, studying systems flow, data usage and work processes
  
Investigating problem areas followed by the software development life cycle
  
Facilitate root cause analysis of the system issues and problem statement
  
Identify ideas to improve system performance and impact availability
  
Analyze client requirements and convert requirements to feasible design
  
Collaborate with functional teams or systems analysts who carry out the detailed investigation into software requirements
  
Conferring with project managers to obtain information on software capabilities
  
͏
  
  

2\. Perform coding and ensure optimal software/ module development
  
  

Determine operational feasibility by evaluating analysis, problem definition, requirements, software development and proposed software
  
Develop and automate processes for software validation by setting up and designing test cases/scenarios/usage cases, and executing these cases
  
Modifying software to fix errors, adapt it to new hardware, improve its performance, or upgrade interfaces.
  
Analyzing information to recommend and plan the installation of new systems or modifications of an existing system
  
Ensuring that code is error free or has no bugs and test failure
  
Preparing reports on programming project specifications, activities and status
  
Ensure all the codes are raised as per the norm defined for project / program / account with clear description and replication patterns
  
Compile timely, comprehensive and accurate documentation and reports as requested
  
Coordinating with the team on daily project status and progress and documenting it
  
Providing feedback on usability and serviceability, trace the result to quality risk and report it to concerned stakeholders
  
͏
  
  

3\. Status Reporting and Customer Focus on an ongoing basis with respect to project and its execution
  
  

Capturing all the requirements and clarifications from the client for better quality work
  
Taking feedback on the regular basis to ensure smooth and on time delivery
  
Participating in continuing education and training to remain current on best practices, learn new programming languages, and better assist other team members.
  
Consulting with engineering staff to evaluate software\-hardware interfaces and develop specifications and performance requirements
  
Document and demonstrate solutions by developing documentation, flowcharts, layouts, diagrams, charts, code comments and clear code
  
Documenting very necessary details and reports in a formal way for proper understanding of software from client proposal to implementation
  
Ensure good quality of interaction with customer w.r.t. e\-mail content, fault report tracking, voice calls, business etiquette etc
  
Timely Response to customer requests and no instances of complaints either internally or externally
  
͏
  
  

Deliver
  
  

No. Performance Parameter Measure
  
1\. Continuous Integration, Deployment \& Monitoring of Software 100% error free on boarding \& implementation, throughput %, Adherence to the schedule/ release plan
  
2\. Quality \& CSAT On\-Time Delivery, Manage software, Troubleshoot queries, Customer experience, completion of assigned certifications for skill upgradation
  
3\. MIS \& Reporting 100% on time MIS \& report generation
  
  

**Mandatory Skills:** Python for Insights .
  
  

**Experience:** 5\-8 Years .
  
  

Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

Hyderabad, Telangana, IN
  
  

**\#job\-location.job\-location\-inline { display:** inline; }
  
**Function:** VIBS
  
  

**About:**  

Vodafone Idea Limited is an Aditya Birla Group and Vodafone Group partnership. It is India’s leading telecom service provider. The Company provides pan India Voice and Data services across 2G, 3G and 4G platform. With the large spectrum portfolio to support the growing demand for data and voice, the company is committed to deliver delightful customer experiences and contribute towards creating a truly ‘Digital India’ by enabling millions of citizens to connect and build a better tomorrow. The Company is developing infrastructure to introduce newer and smarter technologies, making both retail and enterprise customers future ready with innovative offerings, conveniently accessible through an ecosystem of digital channels as well as extensive on\-ground presence. The Company is listed on National Stock Exchange (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) in India.
  
  

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. At VIL, we know that diversity makes us stronger. We are committed to a collaborative, inclusive environment that encourages authenticity and fosters a sense of belonging. We strive for everyone to feel valued, connected and empowered to reach their potential and contribute their best.
  
  

VIL's goal is to build and maintain a workforce that is diverse in experience and background but uniform in reflecting our Values of Passion, Boldness, Trust, Speed and Digital. Consequently, our recruiting efforts are directed towards attracting and retaining best and brightest talents. Our endeavour is to be First Choice for prospective employees.
  
  

VIL ensures equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment based on race, colour, religion, creed, age, sex, sex stereotype, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital and civil partnership/union status, pregnancy, veteran or military service status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  

VIL is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversifying its workforce.
  
  

A Government Account Manager for Enterprise Business in a telecom company is responsible for driving revenue growth, managing high\-value public sector accounts, and navigating complex government procurement processes. This role bridges the gap between telecom technology and public sector needs, ensuring strict compliance with regulatory and tendering frameworks.
  
  

Job Summary
  
  

The Government Account Manager oversees a portfolio of state, local government agencies, and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs). The primary objective is to build strategic relationships with key decision\-makers, identify new business opportunities, and manage the end\-to\-end bidding process (RFPs/Tenders). This position requires a strong blend of technical telecommunications knowledge, commercial acumen, and public sector compliance expertise.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

Account Management \& Relationship Building
  
  

Act as the primary point of contact for assigned government agencies and PSUs.
  
Map accounts comprehensively to identify key stakeholders and decision\-makers.
  
Establish and nurture long\-term strategic relationships to ensure customer retention.
  
Deliver executive\-level presentations and effectively handle CXO\-level discussions. \[
  
  

Sales \& Revenue Generation
  
  

Meet and exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales, order booking, and revenue targets.
  
Upsell and cross\-sell core telecom products, including dedicated internet, MPLS, SD\-WAN, Cloud, IoT, IoT security, and voice solutions.
  
Protect existing revenue streams by managing contract renewals and mitigating churn.
  
Oversee timely billing collections and resolve commercial disputes efficiently.
  
  

Tender \& Bid Management
  
  

Monitor government portal platforms for relevant upcoming RFPs, RFIs, and tenders.
  
Manage tender specifications during the pre\-RFP stage to align solutions with client requirements.
  
Collaborate with internal Solutions,technical Support Groups (TSG), legal, and pricing teams to build competitive bids.
  
Ensure absolute compliance with all government procurement regulations and reporting standards.
  
  

Cross\-Functional Coordination
  
  

Partner with engineering and network teams to ensure smooth service delivery and SLA adherence.
  
Coordinate with external system integrators (SIs) and vendors for complex, large\-scale project execution.
  
Provide accurate market intelligence regarding competitor movements and public sector spending trends.
  
  

Skills \& Qualifications
  
  

Education \& Experience
  
  

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (ECE/CS/IT), Business Administration, or a related technical field. An MBA is highly preferred.
  
**Experience:** 10 to 15 years of experience in enterprise sales or account management within the telecom, ISP, or System Integration sectors.
  
**Sector Expertise:** Proven track record of managing public sector accounts and winning complex government tenders.
  
  

Technical \& Professional Skills
  
  

Deep knowledge of telecom products, including cloud architecture, next\-gen networking, data, and voice services.
  
Thorough understanding of public sector procurement, compliance frameworks, and legal regulations.
  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to structure complex, multi\-year financial deals.
  
Exceptional negotiation, bid management, and proposal\-writing skills.
  
  

Work Environment
  
  

This is a field\-intensive role that often requires up to 75% travel for client engagement, status meetings, and liaison activities.
  
  

Vodafone Idea Limited (formerly Idea Cellular Limited)
  
An Aditya Birla Group \& Vodafone partnership

jobs.title: Advanced Business Analyst II
jobs.description:
As one of the world’s leading independent global investment firms, Invesco is dedicated to rethinking possibilities for our clients. By delivering the combined power of our distinctive investment management capabilities, we provide a wide range of investment strategies and vehicles to our clients around the world. If you're looking for challenging work, intelligent colleagues, and exposure across a global footprint, come explore your potential at Invesco.

**Job Description**
===================


Below are the key responsibilities associated with these roles. Please review them and let us know whether you are interested in and capable of performing these responsibilities.

* Understand the full Distribution business processes and data flows to provide meaningful insights and improvements, including both the Retail and Institutional Asset Management business.
* Work closely with business teams to gather and document their data needs, identify key data sources, and collaborate with stakeholders and technology teams to resolve data\-related issues.
* Lead interviews, and discussions to capture the right requirements and ensure alignment.
* Use your strong industry knowledge to provide context and insight that enhances decision\-making.
* Validate how data is consumed across reports, websites, dashboards, and applications, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across all systems.
* Query Snowflake and other databases efficiently to extract and analyze data.
* Run APIs as part of data integration and validation processes.
* Analyze data quality issues, identify exceptions, and recommend remediation strategies.
* Apply strong analytical skills to interpret data and support business objectives.
* Translate business requirements into detailed technical instructions that engineering teams can use to build and troubleshoot solutions during development and production.
* Support Product Owners by helping prioritize and refine the backlog, managing scope, and participating actively in Agile ceremonies.
* Lead User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to confirm that solutions meet business expectations.
* Keep stakeholders informed with clear project updates and risk communications.
* Work with both senior and junior colleagues across business and technology teams, fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing.

=========================

===============

**Why Invesco**


In Invesco, we act with integrity and do meaningful work to create impact for our stakeholders. We believe our culture is stronger when we all feel we belong, and we respect each other’s identities, lives, health, and well\-being. We come together to create better solutions for our clients, our business and each other by building on different voices and perspectives. We nurture and encourage each other to ensure our meaningful growth, both personally and professionally.


We believe in diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone feels equally valued, and this starts at the top with our senior leaders having diversity and inclusion goals. Our global focus on diversity and inclusion has grown exponentially and we encourage connection and community through our many employee\-led Business Resource Groups (BRGs).


**What’s in it for you?**


As an organization we support personal needs, diverse backgrounds and provide internal networks, as well as opportunities to get involved in the community and in the world.

* Competitive Compensation

In Invesco, we offer development opportunities that help you thrive as a lifelong learner in a constantly evolving business environment and ensure your constant growth. Our AI enabled learning platform delivers curated content based on your role and interest. We ensure our manager and leaders also have many opportunities to advance their skills and competencies that becomes pivotal in their continuous pursuit of performance excellence.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Java Full Stack
jobs.description:
**About this role:**


Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Software Engineer

**In this role, you will:**

* Lead moderately complex initiatives and deliverables within technical domain environments
* Contribute to large scale planning of strategies
* Design, code, test, debug, and document for projects and programs associated with technology domain, including upgrades and deployments
* Review moderately complex technical challenges that require an in\-depth evaluation of technologies and procedures
* Resolve moderately complex issues and lead a team to meet existing client needs or potential new clients needs while leveraging solid understanding of the function, policies, procedures, or compliance requirements
* Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid\-level managers to resolve technical challenges and achieve goals
* Lead projects and act as an escalation point, provide guidance and direction to less experienced staff

 **Required Qualifications:**

* 4\+ years of Software Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education

**Desired Qualifications:**

* Experience in the Cloud technologies like OpenShift /PCF etc.
* Proficiency in developing web\-based applications, should have experience in UI and Server technologies (ANGULAR / React, Spring Framework, JDBC, JavaBeans).
* Experience in developing client\-side UI components using Angular / React.  

Experience in developing the functionalities, enhancements and bug fixes for application (UI/Backend) by consuming and exposing services.
* Designing, implementing and maintaining Java services with well\-designed, efficient and test driven code.
* Experience in Developing Restful Web services and Micro services in java by using Spring boot.
* Develop service/business layer components using Spring and EJBS.  

Should be able to design and develop MVC restful services using JAVA spring boot (MVC) with Oracle/SQL Server Database.
* Strong knowledge of Junit/TestNG, Selenium frameworks and test automation.
* Design cross platform consumption patterns, microservices, and event\-driven architectures for high availability and scalability.
* Experience with Autosys similar orchestration tools. Working knowledge of REST APIs, Object Storage, and CI/CD pipelines

**Job Expectations:**

* Involve in end –end lifecycle of Product/Application development, analyze highly complex business requirements, designs and writes technical specifications to design or redesign complex modules and applications.
* Develop highly complex original code and provide coding direction to junior team members
* Proficiency with Agile, DevOps practices, delivering Cloud solutions. Experience with delivering projects using Agile software development techniques.
* Advanced knowledge of object oriented design and development (OOA/OOD) and the JAVA patterns and practices
* Must possess innovative and Out\-of\-box thinking while developing advanced technical solutions to business problems and grab opportunities to improve system resiliency.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to build scalable, high‑performance cloud native solutions using Java, Python, microservices, and Autosys.

**Posting End Date:**

jobs.title: Product Manager — Intelligence & Internal Systems
jobs.description:
We're hiring:
 




  





 Product Manager — Intelligence \& Internal Systems —
 
 1acre.in
 
  






 Land is the most opaque market in India. People still get burned buying a plot because the basic information — is it verified, who owns it, what's the master plan, can I even reach the seller — is scattered or hidden.
 




  






 We're fixing that. 1acre is India's verified land \& plot marketplace: 16,000\+ verified lands and plots on one live map, real sellers you can contact directly, no spam. Mission is simple — solve the information problem in land. Verify it, make it instantly discoverable, help people transact at scale. Then take it global.
 




  






 Two things here are bottlenecked on people, not ideas. Our intelligence layers need to expand faster and hold higher quality. And our internal teams are managing deal flow without a system that fits how land actually gets sold. You own both — with AI as a force multiplier at every step.
 




  





  





**WHAT YOU'LL OWN** 




  





**Data layers \& intelligence** 



* Sourcing, coverage, and quality of our map layers — survey numbers, master plans, metro, air funnels, cadastral, heritage.
* The full pipeline from raw government or survey data to a published, verified, correctly\-attributed layer, plus the state\-wise layer pages that go with it.
* Coverage and accuracy are your numbers. When a layer is wrong, it's yours to catch before a user does.
* This work directly feeds our organic search strategy — every well\-built layer page is a page that can rank. You'll work closely with the Senior PM on it.



  





**CRM \& internal deal\-flow systems** 



* Sales and ops teams currently manage buyer enquiries, seller onboarding, and verification without custom tooling.
* Choose, configure, and run the CRM, including land deal pipeline stages, lead routing, WhatsApp/call\-log integration, ownership rules, and reporting.
* Drive CRM adoption by observing team workflows directly and removing friction.



  





**Instrumentation \& reporting** 



* Define and maintain the Mixpanel event layer.
* Build the funnels and dashboards the team makes decisions on.
* Publish the weekly numbers, and be the person who notices something moved and says so before anyone asks.



  





**Quality, end to end** 



* Turn problems into specs crisp enough that both engineers and AI agents can build from them with zero guesswork.
* Partner with design (Figma) on flows, edge cases, empty and error states, and the copy that goes with them.
* Own the test plan. Verify on real devices. Confirm the analytics events actually fire. Sign off before anything launches.
* Content audits, competitor teardowns, support\-ticket patterns. Unglamorous, and the fastest way to learn where the product actually hurts.



  





  





**HOW WE WORK** 




**We ship, then we decide.** 

 Something small in front of real users in two weeks beats two months of research. Features get killed often and that's normal — the point is to learn fast, not to be right the first time.
 




  




* **Bias to action:** 

 When something is unclear, go find out. Don't wait for the answer to arrive in a meeting.
* **Clear ownership and tracking:** 

 Every launch carries a metric and a decision date before it goes out.
* **Radical transparency:** 

 When something you built isn't working, say so early. Nobody here is punished for that. Sitting on it is the actual mistake.



  





  





**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS** 




**Month 1** 

 — Learn the product cold: every filter, every layer, every listing flow. Sit with the verification and ops teams and follow a listing from submission to live. Get on 10 buyer and seller calls and write up what you heard.
 




  





**Month 2** 

 — Own your first layer end to end, from data sourcing to published page. Map the deal\-flow process as it actually runs, not as anyone says it runs.
 




  





**Month 3** 

 — CRM configured and used daily by the sales team. Weekly metrics report running without anyone asking for it.
 




  





  





  





**YOU'RE A FIT IF YOU** 




  




* Have ≈1–2 years of work experience. Your function matters less than your curiosity and your throughput — analyst, engineering, ops, growth, consulting, or PM all work.
* Are comfortable with data and unforgiving detail. Spreadsheets fluent, willing to learn SQL fast. Layer work punishes carelessness.
* Are genuinely AI\-native — you use LLMs every day to spec, prototype, clean data, test, and analyze, and you have real opinions about where they help.
* Write with precision. Short sentences, real conclusions, nothing ambiguous.
* Are organised enough to run a system other people depend on.
* Treat QA as your job, not someone else's — it's not "done" until you've tried to break it.
* Know (or will rapidly learn) the Indian land context — survey numbers, plots vs lands, cents/gaj, master plans, district\-level nuance.
* Will go to the field. Site visits, revenue offices, conversations with agents in their language.
* Take feedback well and act on it the same week.
* Sweat the details AND move fast. Both, not one.



  





**BONUS POINTS** 



* Any exposure to GIS, maps, QGIS, or government land records.
* Have set up or administered a CRM — HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Kylas, LeadSquared, any of them.
* SQL, Python, or scripting to clean and reconcile messy datasets.
* Telugu, Kannada, Tamil, or Hindi for user and agent conversations.
* Hands\-on with Figma, Linear/Jira, Mixpanel/Google Analytics.
* A side project, teardown, or portfolio — anything showing you think about products unprompted.



  





**WHY 1ACRE** 




  




* **A real problem at real scale:** 

 Every honest fix here protects someone's life savings.
* **AI\-first for real:** 

 We ship with modern AI tooling, we don't just talk about it.

 Your work goes live, not into a backlog.

jobs.description:
**Description**
 Amazon Customer Service supports customers around the world through a large and diverse global workforce. The experience our Customer Service Associates have at work directly affects their ability to successfully serve customers.
   

  

 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to reimagine the day\-to\-day experience of being a Customer Service Associate and define the future of our Associate Workspace.
   

  

 Our ambition is to make work simpler, more personalized, connected and engaging. Associates should have a coherent experience through which they can manage their workday, understand what matters to them, stay informed about changes, see their performance and progress, interact with their teams, and feel recognized for the work they do.
   

  

 Today, many of these experiences are fragmented across different tools, systems and communication channels. The opportunity is not simply to aggregate them into a single interface. It is to rethink the experience from first principles around what associates need to successfully navigate and engage with their work.
   

  

 Imagine an experience that understands each associate and their context and helps answer: What do I need to know today? What has changed? What actions do I need to take? How am I doing? What opportunities are available to me? How can I better connect with my team and organization?
   

  

 The opportunity also extends beyond simplifying work. We want to explore how recognition, community, interaction and thoughtfully designed engagement mechanisms can make work more motivating and connected. This could include new ways to celebrate progress and achievements, create team experiences, or use gamification to make appropriate aspects of work more engaging, while thoughtfully navigating privacy, regulatory and cultural considerations across our global workforce.
   

  

 As the Principal PM, you will define the long\-term product vision and strategy for this experience. You will determine how capabilities spanning work management, communications, performance visibility, recognition, engagement and personalization should come together into a coherent product.
   

  

 This is a highly ambiguous, zero\-to\-one role with significant cross\-organizational scope. Many underlying capabilities will continue to be owned by other teams. You will establish the product experience and architecture that brings them together, influence partner roadmaps, and align senior Product, Engineering, UX, Science and Operations leaders around a common direction.
   

  

 You will also define how AI and associate context can make the experience increasingly proactive and personalized, reducing friction and cognitive load while giving associates greater visibility and control over their work experience.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a product leader who can move fluidly between customer insight, product strategy and technology. You should be comfortable identifying opportunities that are not yet well defined, creating clarity from ambiguity, influencing senior leaders without direct authority, and translating a long\-term vision into incremental customer value.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As the Principal Product Manager for Associate Workspace, you will:
   

  

* Define the long\-term vision, product strategy and roadmap for the day\-to\-day associate experience across Amazon Customer Service.
* Work directly with associates and Operations to identify the most important problems and opportunities to improve their experience at work.
* Define a coherent experience spanning areas such as work and schedule management, communications and change, performance and progress visibility, recognition, community, engagement and interaction.
* Develop new ways to make work more engaging, including recognition, team experiences and gamification, while partnering with Legal, HR and other teams to ensure experiences are appropriate for a diverse global workforce.
* Define how associate context and personalization should shape the information, actions and experiences surfaced to each associate.
* Establish product principles and architecture that allow capabilities owned by multiple organizations and systems to behave as a unified experience.
* Define how AI can simplify the associate experience, reduce cognitive load and make the Workspace increasingly proactive and personalized.
* Partner with senior Engineering and UX leaders to make product and technical choices that enable the long\-term vision while delivering value incrementally.
* Establish and influence cross\-organizational roadmaps, priorities and ownership boundaries required to deliver the experience.
* Define success measures that go beyond adoption to understand tool effectiveness, friction, cognitive load, effort, engagement and associate experience, and connect improvements where possible to operational and customer outcomes.
* Influence senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Science, Operations and partner organizations to align around and deliver a common associate experience.


**Basic Qualifications**
* 10\+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* 10\+ years of blending product and program management skills to execute strategic initiatives about process creation, standardization, and improvement experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience owning technology products

You will report to the Director of Product Engineering (India), with a dotted line to the Sr. Director of Engineering (US), and you'll sit on the India engineering leadership team. You'll provide leadership across platform modernization, reliability, and operational excellence while developing future team leaders and strengthening the team's management structure.

ScienceLogic scored a leadership position in the “Forrester Wave” AI Observability report. * Owning hiring, onboarding, performance management, and career development for direct reports.
* Representing the India platform team in planning and reviews with Mahesh Hanumanula and other US engineering leadership.
* Driving infrastructure cost optimization and rightsizing across on\-premises (VMware) and AWS environments.
* Participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and driving continuous improvement in system operations and release readiness.

**Qualities you possess...**

**Must have:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 10\+ years of engineering experience, including at least 3 years leading engineering teams. People\-management experience is required for this role, not a nice\-to\-have.
* Demonstrated experience growing a team's structure, hiring into a growing org, and ideally building or mentoring a first layer of team leads.
* A hands\-on background in systems engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering: comfortable reviewing architecture, debugging production issues, and making infrastructure decisions rather than just relaying them.
* Strong understanding of Linux administration, automation, and cloud infrastructure.
* Working knowledge of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, routing) sufficient to guide a networking specialist on the team.
* Experience with CI/CD and infrastructure\-as\-code practices (e.g., Terraform, Jenkins).
* Comfortable operating across a matrixed reporting structure and collaborating with stakeholders in different time zones.

**Good to have:**

* AWS experience or certification.
* Scripting or programming experience (Python, Golang, or Bash).
* Exposure to AI\-driven development practices or AI coding assistants.
* CCNA/CCNP or equivalent networking certification.
* Experience with distributed systems or large\-scale data processing environments.

*Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At ScienceLogic, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.*

 *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which you are applying.*

 Incedo is a US\-based consulting, data science and technology services firm with over 4000 people helping clients from our six offices across US, Mexico and India. We help our clients achieve competitive advantage through end\-to\-end digital transformation.  The Senior Product Owner will lead the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of digital payment capabilities, with a focus on
 **real‑time money movement** 
 ,
 **P2P payments**

 .

 **payment rails** 
 , the

 , and financial‑services regulatory frameworks.

**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience with banking core systems, payment orchestration engines, or API‑driven financial platforms.
* Familiarity with network certification processes, fraud‑detection tools, or risk‑scoring models.
* Certifications such as CSPO, PSPO, SAFe PO/PM, or equivalent.
* Experience working in consulting or client‑facing delivery environments.

 Salesforce is the \#1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
   

  

 Ready to level\-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
   

  

 The mission of the
 **Agentic Transformation team** 
 within the
 **Solutions and Builder Center of Excellence (CoE)** 
 is to redesign day\-in\-the\-life SE \& Builder workflows with supporting agentic harnesses and best in class experiences to help them deliver their best work and drive customer outcomes.
   

  

**Role Description**
 We are looking for a
 **Lead Technical Product Owner**

You will serve as the connectivity hub for the entire organization, bridging the gap between our Central Core technology, our agentic portfolio and the needs in the field.

* Project/Program Management (Business Owner)
* Enterprise Backlog Management: Define enterprise\-level backlog management standards for AI initiatives. Shape organizational priorities and model advanced prioritization practices for other Product Owners.


**Basic Requirements**
* Experience: Minimum of 8\+ years of professional experience, with a strong background in Product Ownership, Solution Engineering, or Product Management.
* Technical Expertise: Knowledge of Salesforce AI capabilities (Agentforce, Slackbot) and Data 360, with the ability to anticipate product trends and align them with technical solutions.
* Agile Mastery: Experience acting as a Product Owner in a scaled Agile environment. Proven track record of aligning backlog priorities with business objectives and delivering high\-value increments.
* Communication: Strong oral, written, and presentation skills. Ability to establish enterprise\-wide standards for clear communication


**Preferred Requirements**
* Experience leading complex, cross\-functional technical initiatives or portfolio\-level backlog management.
* Previous experience as a Solution Engineer (SE) or Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) in a pre\-sales environment.

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities.  Quality solutions Veeva Quality One, LabWare LIMS, Empower CDS and Chromeleon CDS

**Risk Consulting – Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) – Basel III Business Analyst – Manager/Senior**
**Description**
 EY's Financial Services Office (FSO) is a unique, industry\-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional capability and product knowledge. FSO practice provides integrated consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, investment banks, broker\-dealers, asset managers (traditional and alternative), insurance and energy trading companies, and the Corporate Treasury functions of leading Fortune 500 Companies. The service offerings provided by the FSO Consulting include: market, credit and operational risk management, regulatory consulting, quantitative consulting, structured finance transaction, actuarial consulting, technology enablement, risk and security, program consulting, and process \& controls.
   

  

 Within EY’s Business Consulting Practice, the Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group provides solutions that can help FSO clients to identify, measure, manage and monitor the market (trading book), credit (banking book), operational, and regulatory risks associated with their trading, asset\-liability management, capital management and other capital markets activities.
   

  

 Within FSRM, the CSTC team assists across end\-to\-end aspects of Capital management, BASEL, credit risk and Stress testing related activities:
   

  

* Key role involves producing critical deliverables to the senior management and regulators including EMEIA, US and APAC entities’ credit risk review, capital projections, Basel 4, Basel 3 endgame, capital aspects of Recovery \& Resolution planning (RRP), stress testing and having oversight of various regulatory requirements.
* Consulting and solutions delivery such as impact assessments, defining the target operating model, and integrated risk and finance reporting framework
* Quality assurance such as assessment of controls of the Banking industry and similar business lines covering regulatory reporting involving Basel/CRR/RRP regulations
* Early identification and accurate analysis of prudential developments and influence on changes to the capital framework.
* Regulatory capital impact assessment in legal entity simplification initiatives, business re\-organizations, new business initiatives and external commitments to regulators


 Clients include large domestic and global financial institutions, broker\-dealers, foreign banking organizations, asset management firms with significant capital markets activities. Project teams frequently work with the senior management of these firms, including CFOs and CROs.
   

  

**Role Overview**

**Some careers open more doors than others.**

  

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.J

  

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best\-in\-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.

 **Job Introduction**

  

The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer\-facing, primarily servicing walk\-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client\-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.

 **Principal Responsibilities**

  

* Provide high\-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross\-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross\-selling opportunities.

 **Education Qualifications / Certifications and Requirements**

  

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

 **Other Requirements (Knowledge and Experience)**

  

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well\-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self\-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

 **Skills**

* **Exceptional Communication Skills:** Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* **Strong Interpersonal Skills:** Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* **Highly Organized:** Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* **Collaborative Team Player:** Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* **Proactive and Efficient:** Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

 **Regulatory Certifications:**

  

FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding

  

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision\-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.


HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a people leader who thrives on building high\-performing teams and driving operational excellence in a defined problem space? Amazon is seeking a Manager II, Risk who will lead a team of risk professionals focused on Safety, Trust and compliance worldwide. In this role, you will operate as a non\-technical "solution architect" — managing a team that detects bad actors and maintains high bar on network safety  

  

You will be responsible for goals in an area where the strategy is already defined, using your subject matter expertise to decide which actions to take, who will own them, and in what priority order to meet short\-term goals. You will lead your team to deliver results by establishing the right team structure, driving operational excellence, and ensuring high\-quality outcomes. This role requires influencing your team's roadmap, reaching consensus on approach, and delivering to meet business needs while actively developing your people and fostering an inclusive team culture.  

  

The ideal candidate is a tactical manager learning to be strategic — someone who ensures each individual on their team has the right level of support to meet operational and development objectives, while driving the team toward meaningful impact on network safety for Amazon customers  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Overall Responsibilities  

* Lead and manage a team of risk specialists responsible for protecting Amazon and our customers from transportation related fraud, misuse, and abuse worldwide
* Support process improvement, automation, and control implementation projects
* Drive and own the standardization and documentation of processes (SOPs), risks, and controls and work with owners to assign accountability
* Drive high quality operations with zero error tolerance to errors; operate as an SME of the process while grooming process expertise within the team

  

Team and People Management  

* Attract and hire bar\-raising talent who bring needed skills and expertise to the team
* Facilitate career growth conversations, provide constructive feedback, and align individual goals to areas of interest; identify mentors and supportive stakeholders for your employees
* Evaluate employees against appropriate role guidelines, participate in calibration activities, and clearly communicate performance expectations in regular 1:1s
* Create and continuously improve the team environment so that every employee feels valued, trusted, connected, and informed. Navigate challenging conversations with empathy

  

Execution \& Delivery  

  

* Lead your team to deliver results against defined program goals
* Conduct risk assessments for current functions and operational processes; identify gaps in safety and compliance controls
* Manage end\-to\-end escalation lifecycle including intake, deep dive, issue resolution, root cause analysis, preventative actions, and outcome summarization
* Identify risks and bring them to the attention of your manager, customers, or stakeholders with mitigation plans before they become roadblocks; know when to escalate
* Make trade\-offs between time, quality, and resources to meet business needs
* Audit employee work to ensure results are high quality and meet SLAs
* Actively manage your team's commitments, recognizing capacity constraints

  

Problem Solving \& Process Improvement  

  

* Dive into details, ask the right questions, and drive the right customer outcomes
* Prioritize root cause resolution, process improvements, and operational excellence
* Identify and optimize workflows and best practices; partner with teams to improve mechanisms and drive enhancements
* Develop and implement key process governance mechanisms across the program
* Support the development of daily, weekly, and monthly metrics; leverage data to drive continuous improvement

  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Communication  

  

* Engage cross\-functional stakeholders (Legal, Tech, Ops, Business) to collaborate on escalations and align on frameworks
* Present decisions, learnings, and recommendations to leaders up to three tiers
* Write clear documentation including narratives, MBR/QBR materials, and COEs
* Create plans, communicate requirements, negotiate priorities, and clarify what success looks like
* Foster shared understanding across an increasing diversity of roles and functions
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of auditing business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance or internal audits experience
* 3\+ years of work in relevant industries such as law, customer service, investigations, risk, compliance or project management experience
* Experience in audits related to business processes, risk mitigation, program compliance, or internal audits
* Experience working in relevant industries such as law, customer service, investigations, risk, compliance or project management
* Experience with all Microsoft Office applications
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification
* Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions and implement effective solutions
* Experience working in risk, fraud or compliance organizations
* Master's degree or equivalent

jobs.description:
Yubi, formerly known as CredAvenue, is re\-defining global debt markets by freeing the flow of finance between borrowers, lenders, and investors. We are the world's possibility platform for the discovery, investment, fulfillment, and collection of any debt solution. At Yubi, opportunities are plenty and we equip you with tools to seize it.
 



  





 In March 2022, we became India's fastest fintech and most impactful startup to join the unicorn club with a Series B fundraising round of $137 million.
 



  





 In 2020, we began our journey with a vision of transforming and deepening the global institutional debt market through technology. Our two\-sided debt marketplace helps institutional and HNI investors find the widest network of corporate borrowers and debt products on one side and helps corporates to discover investors and access debt capital efficiently on the other side. Switching between platforms is easy, which means investors can lend, invest and trade bonds \- all in one place. All of our platforms shake up the traditional debt ecosystem and offer new ways of digital finance.
 



  





**Yubi Credit Marketplace** 
 \- With the largest selection of lenders on one platform, our credit marketplace helps enterprises partner with lenders of their choice for any and all capital requirements.
 



**Yubi Invest** 
 \- Fixed income securities platform for wealth managers \& financial advisors to channel client investments in fixed income
 



**Financial Services Platform** 
 \- Designed for financial institutions to manage co\-lending partnerships \& asset based securitization
 



**Spocto** 
 \- Debt recovery \& risk mitigation platform
 



**Corpository** 
 \- Dedicated SaaS solutions platform powered by Decision\-grade data, Analytics, Pattern Identifications, Early Warning Signals and Predictions to Lenders, Investors and Business Enterprises
 



  





 So far, we have on\-boarded over 17000\+ enterprises, 6200\+ investors \& lenders and have facilitated debt volumes of over INR 1,40,000 crore.
 



 Backed by marquee investors like Insight Partners, B Capital Group, Dragoneer, Sequoia Capital, LightSpeed and Lightrock, we are the only\-of\-its\-kind debt platform globally, revolutionizing the segment.
 



  





 At Yubi, People are at the core of the business and our most valuable assets. Yubi is constantly growing, with 1000\+ like\-minded individuals today, who are changing the way people perceive debt. We are a fun bunch who are highly motivated and driven to create a purposeful impact. Come, join the club to be a part of our epic growth story.

 We are seeking a dynamic and driven Senior Product Manager to lead the development and enhancement of our financial technology products. The ideal candidate will have understanding of the fintech landscape, a passion for innovation, and the ability to translate market needs into actionable product strategies. As a Senior Product Manager, you will collaborate with cross\-functional teams to deliver products that meet customer needs and drive business growth.

* **Product Strategy and Vision** 
 : Develop and articulate a clear product vision and strategy for our fintech products, aligned with company goals and market opportunities.
* **Market Research and Analysis** 
 : Conduct thorough market research to identify customer needs, market trends, and competitive landscape. Use insights to inform product development and positioning.
* **Roadmap Planning** 
 : Create and maintain a product roadmap that prioritizes features and enhancements based on business objectives, customer feedback, and market demands.
* **Feature Definition:** 
 Clearly define and prioritize product features, ensuring they meet the requirements of B2B clients and contribute to the overall success of the product.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 
 : Work closely with engineering, design, marketing, sales, and customer support teams to ensure successful product development and launch.
* **Requirements Gathering** 
 : Collect and document detailed product requirements from stakeholders and customers. Translate these requirements into clear and actionable tasks for the development team.
* **Project Management** 
 : Oversee the product development lifecycle, from ideation to launch, ensuring timely delivery of high\-quality products. Manage project timelines, resources, and budgets.
* **User Experience Focus** 
 : Advocate for the end\-user by ensuring products are intuitive, user\-friendly, and deliver a seamless experience. Conduct user testing and gather feedback to drive continuous improvement.
* **Performance Monitoring** 
 : Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure product success. Use data\-driven insights to make informed decisions and adjustments.
* **Compliance and Security** 
 : Ensure that products comply with relevant financial regulations and industry standards. Prioritize security and data privacy in product design and development.
* **Stakeholder Communication** 
 : Maintain transparent and effective communication with stakeholders, providing regular updates on product status, milestones, and changes.

 DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI\-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Learn why more than 100,000 organizations, including 90% of the Fortune 500, choose DigiCert to stop today’s threats and prepare for a quantum\-safe future at www.digicert.com
 





**Job summary** 






 DigiCert is looking for a Product Manager to help build the next generation of DNS posture management capabilities for enterprise customers. This role will focus on AI\-enabled DNS products that strengthen security, reliability, performance, automation, and operational insight \- helping redefine DNS as an AI\-native trust layer for the modern Internet.
 





 As a Product Manager, you will own well\-defined product areas within DigiCert’s broader DNS roadmap. You will work closely with engineering, architecture, security, ML Ops, product marketing, sales, and customer\-facing teams to translate customer needs, DNS telemetry, and technical capabilities into clear product requirements and measurable outcomes.
 





 This is a hands\-on product role for a builder who can move quickly, use data to make decisions, and partner deeply with technical teams. You will help validate new ideas, prototype posture workflows, define requirements, support launches, and iterate continuously while maintaining enterprise standards for security, reliability, and customer trust.
 




  
 




**What you will do** 




* Define, prioritize, and deliver AI\-enabled DNS product capabilities within DigiCert’s broader DNS roadmap, aligned with the company’s trust and cloud strategy.
* Translate customer problems, DNS telemetry, AI/ML capabilities, and market insights into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and success metrics.
* Partner closely with engineering, architecture, security, and MLOps teams to deliver secure, scalable, cloud\-native DNS services.
* Use AI\-assisted product and prototyping tools to analyze feedback, synthesize insights, explore workflows, and validate ideas early with customers and engineers.
* Develop product capabilities across DNS resolution, traffic management, observability, automation, anomaly detection, posture management, and security use cases.
* Define and track success metrics such as adoption, latency, reliability, automation effectiveness, anomaly\-detection quality, and trust\-signal accuracy.
* Support product\-side GTM execution in partnership with Product Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, including launch planning, messaging input, enablement, pricing input, and adoption tracking.
* Engage customers, partners, internal field teams, and relevant standards communities to validate use cases and inform roadmap priorities.
* Use telemetry, dashboards, customer feedback, experimentation, and A/B testing where appropriate to guide prioritization and measure product impact.
* Rapidly validate ideas, deliver incremental value, and iterate continuously without compromising security, reliability, performance, or customer trust.



  
 




**What you will have** 




* 4\+ years of product management experience in cloud, networking, security, infrastructure SaaS, developer platforms, or technical B2B products.
* Experience working closely with engineering teams building on AWS, Azure, GCP, or similar cloud platforms.
* Understanding of DNS, networking, distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or adjacent technical domains.
* Familiarity with AI/ML product concepts such as inference workflows, automation, anomaly detection, model evaluation, or MLOps collaboration.
* Experience translating ambiguous technical problems into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and delivery milestones.
* Proven ability to deliver 0→1 or early\-stage product capabilities and iterate rapidly in agile environments.
* Strong analytical and storytelling skills, with the ability to use data, customer insights, and technical tradeoffs to drive product decisions.
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted tools such as Figma, Cursor, Copilot, or similar tools to accelerate discovery, prototyping, feedback synthesis, or requirements development.
* Experience supporting GTM activities such as launches, collateral, enablement, pricing input, customer adoption, or success tracking.
* Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across engineering, product marketing, sales, customer success, support, and leadership stakeholders.
* Self\-starter with an ownership mindset, strong attention to detail, and a passion for building secure, reliable, enterprise\-grade infrastructure products.



  
 




**Nice to have** 




* Experience with DNS, traffic management, network security, observability, or infrastructure automation.
* Experience bringing startup\-style urgency to enterprise\-grade products.
* Builder mindset with comfort operating in ambiguous 0→1 environments.
* Strong instincts for security, trust, automation, and operational resilience.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native and open\-source infrastructure ecosystems.



  
 




**Benefits** 




* Generous time off policies.
* Top shelf benefits.
* Education, wellness and lifestyle support.

 : 4\.00 \+ years
   

  

**Salary** 
 : Confidential (based on experience)
   

  

**Expected Notice Period** 
 : 15 Days
   

  

**Shift** 
 : (GMT\+05:30\) Asia/Kolkata (IST)

 : Hybrid ()
   

  

**Placement Type** 
 : Full Time Permanent position(Payroll and Compliance to be managed by: Z1\)
   

  

**(\*Note: This is a requirement for one of Uplers' client \- Z1\)
   

  

**What do you need for this opportunity?
   

  

**Must have skills required:**
 Communication, AI, API, B2B, GenAI, Product Management
   

  

**Z1 is Looking for:**
 Senior Product Manager – AI Transformation****
 Experience: 4–6 years \| Bengaluru \| US Market Focus
   

  

**About Us**
 We solves large, complex AI problems and builds the platforms that enable companies to use AI for large\-scale business transformation.
   

  

 We operate in a technology space that is rapidly becoming one of the most important layers of the modern enterprise. As AI moves from isolated experiments to becoming embedded across businesses, companies need fundamentally new technology platforms that can bring together models, enterprise data, organizational context, workflows, applications and people at scale.
   

  

 Our enterprise AI platform forms the foundation of our transformation work. We use this platform to configure and extend AI\-native solutions around how each organization operates, rather than approaching every customer problem as a bespoke software development exercise.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Senior Product Manager – AI Transformation, you will be a central owner of our AI transformation deployments, responsible for translating complex business problems into AI products and driving them through successful delivery.
   

  

 Our customers engage us to transform meaningful parts of how their businesses operate. You will be responsible for understanding the business context and problem, defining the scope, designing the solution, determining how our platform should be applied or extended, and working closely with engineering through implementation and deployment.
   

  

 This requires strong first\-principles thinking. Customer requirements are important inputs, but they are not necessarily the solution. You need to understand the underlying problem, question assumptions and develop an independent view of what will create the most value.
   

  

 This is also an execution\-intensive role. Product ownership here does not end with a PRD, prototype or roadmap. A significant part of the job is coordinating dependencies, resolving open questions, reviewing builds, aligning stakeholders and doing the detailed work required to get a product successfully delivered.

Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, this Senior PM partners closely with engineering, sales and GTM, marketing, and the broader AI organization to ship capabilities that solve real problems for our enterprise ICP.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch — at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in enterprise data infrastructure.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
* Product execution within a defined AI capability area: End\-to\-end ownership of one or more capabilities inside the AI portfolio. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption — and the iteration after launch. You contribute to the strategy for the wider portfolio area you sit within, working with the Principal PM and the VP of AI Product Management who set it.
* Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one\-off requests outside the ICP.
* Engineering partnership: Work shoulder\-to\-shoulder with engineering. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one\-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.
* Customer and design partner engagement: Support and run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.
* Cross\-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across the broader product organization — Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team — so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build\-vs\-partner point of view to your area: build where Couchbase is uniquely strong, and surface partnerships and integrations where we can deliver a better customer experience faster.
* Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win in the capabilities you own — positioning, demos, competitive context, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.
* External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.
* AI\-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team's AI\-driven PM and AI\-DLC (AI\-driven development lifecycle) practices in day\-to\-day execution.
* Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early\-career PMs as the team grows.


**What You Will Deliver**
* PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.
* Shipped capabilities in your area with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.
* Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.
* Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win\-rate signals, not enablement\-decks\-produced.
* Contributions to the broader AI portfolio narrative — customer\-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.
* Visible AI\-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI\-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.


**Must Have**
* 7\+ years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, developer tools, or AI infrastructure.
* Technical fluency in modern AI infrastructure: vector search, embeddings, RAG, agent frameworks, model serving, context engineering, and emerging interoperability standards.…

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MEM0**
--------------


We're building the memory layer for AI agents: long\-term memory that lets AI remember conversations, learn from interactions, and build real context over time, the difference between a chatbot and something that actually knows you. We're already powering millions of AI interactions for enterprise customers and a fast\-growing open\-source community (160k\+ developers and counting).


We're backed by top\-tier investors through a $24M Series A \& Seed, early enough that the systems you build now become the foundation everything else is built on.


This role owns the product surface of the Mem0 Platform. You'll build features end to end across Next.js and Python, design the APIs, write the backend logic, own the data models, and ship to production. Our users are developers integrating us into their own agents, so the interface you design is the product as far as they're concerned.


You'll ship fast without trading away code quality, performance, or reliability, and you'll stay with what you build once it's live. You'll work directly with design, research, and customers to turn real problems into product.


This role reports directly to Deshraj Yadav, our Co\-founder and CTO, and works closely with the engineering team in San Francisco.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Ship end\-to\-end features:** Design APIs, build UIs, write backend logic, own data models, and deploy to production.
* **Build for scale and speed:** Optimize latency, caching, and query patterns. Keep pages snappy and backends reliable.
* **Own quality:** Write tests, enforce typing and linting, review PRs, and maintain clean, well\-documented code.
* **Collaborate deeply:** Work with design on UX, with research to integrate new memory capabilities, and with customers to refine requirements.
* **Operate what you build:** Add observability, set alerts, debug production issues, and drive continuous improvements.
* **Lead with product sense:** Prioritize ruthlessly, make trade\-offs explicit, and iterate based on data and feedback.
* **Go beyond your lane:** Unblock teammates, learn new tools on the fly, and do what it takes to deliver.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**
--------------------------

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* 3\+ years of experience shipping full stack web applications at scale using Next.js/React and Python.
* Strong Python fundamentals and familiarity with modern web stacks (REST, Postgres, Redis, Celery or similar queues).
* Solid front\-end depth: component architecture, state management, forms, accessibility, SSR/ISR.
* Track record of owning features end to end, from design doc through rollout and post\-launch iteration.
* Code quality mindset: unit and integration testing, type safety (TypeScript, mypy or pyright), CI/CD, and a thoughtful review culture.
* Comfortable operating production systems (logs, metrics, tracing) and meeting low\-latency requirements.
* Clear communicator who works well across design, research, and GTM.

**NICE TO HAVE**
----------------

* Experience integrating LLM or memory features into products (RAG, embeddings, vector DBs).
* Real\-time features (WebSockets, server actions, streaming), file uploads, and background jobs at scale.
* Infra awareness: Docker, IaC, and basic Kubernetes, Vercel, AWS or GCP deployment patterns, with cost thinking.
* Product and UI polish: Tailwind, design systems, charts, empty states, error UX, performance budgets.
* Security and privacy basics (PII handling, audit logging).
* Prior time at an early\-stage startup. Series A, YC, or founding engineer experience tells us a lot.

**OUR CULTURE**
---------------

* **Velocity with craftsmanship:** We build for the long term, not just shipping features. We move fast but never sacrifice reliability or thoughtful design. Every system needs to be fast, reliable, and elegant.
* **Extreme ownership:** Everyone at Mem0 is a builder\-owner. If you spot a problem or opportunity, you have the agency to fix it. Titles are light; impact is heavy.
* **High bar, high trust:** We hire for talent and potential, then give people room to run. Code is reviewed, ideas are challenged, and wins are celebrated, always with respect and curiosity.
* **Data\-driven, not ego\-driven:** The best solution wins, whether it comes from a founder or an engineer who joined yesterday. We let results and metrics guide our decisions.

**SAP S/4HANA Senior Consultant**  

Inventory Management (IM) / Warehouse Management (WM)
  

  

**Role Overview**  

This role owns the physical and system truth of stock. Today inventory is split between the ERP and a legacy shop\-floor system, movements are tracked on paper and in Excel, hold and defective stock are segregated physically with manual approvals, and shelf\-life and re\-inspection cycles are administered outside the system. Your mandate is to bring all of it into standard S/4HANA IM and WM with batch\-level accuracy, real\-time synchronization to the shop\-floor execution layer, and the product\-specific packing and lot\-handling rules the business genuinely depends on. Lot splitting and merging, cavity\-level sub\-lots, FIFO picking, mixed\-lot restrictions and shelf\-life enforcement are core requirements, not edge cases.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead inventory and warehouse validation workshops across four plants and two divisions; produce signed\-off functional design.Configure Inventory Management: plant and storage\-location structure, movement types, special stocks, transfer postings, goods receipt and issue, physical inventory and cycle counting.Design stock\-status handling across unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked and returns stock, and the system\-driven hold process — hold reasons, re\-inspection results, rework/disposal decisions and scrap — replacing paper forms and physical segregation.Configure Warehouse Management: storage types, bins and sections, putaway and picking strategies, transfer requirements and orders, and the WM–IM interface.Configure FIFO and shelf\-life\-driven picking and batch determination; design picking, packing and shipping for reel, loose\-item, bag and emboss\-tape formats with handling\-unit management.Enforce product\-specific packing and mixing rules in the system — notably that lots with full and partial cavity availability must not be mixed, while lots from different production dates may be.Design hand\-held terminal and barcode/QR transactions for receipt, movement and picking with label printing; design real\-time inventory and consumption synchronization with SAP Digital Manufacturing.
 

**BATCH MANAGEMENT \& TRACEABILITY EXPERIENCE — REQUIRED**

Hands\-on Batch Management and end\-to\-end traceability experience is a mandatory requirement for this role. Batch, lot and cavity\-level traceability sits at the center of this program; candidates without demonstrable hands\-on experience in the following will not be shortlisted:Full batch management configuration: batch level, internal/external number assignment, classification and characteristics, batch status and derivation across plants.Batch determination and search strategies for goods issue, component staging, delivery and picking — FIFO, shelf\-life and characteristic\-driven selection with sort rules and selection classes.Batch split and merge in inventory and warehouse processes: splitting a lot by lot size and down to cavity level, combining partial quantities from different production orders into one pack without loss of lot detail, and unpack/repack cycles.Characteristic inheritance and preservation on every transformation, so production date, mold, machine, active cavity count and source survive splitting, merging and repacking.SLED management, remaining\-shelf\-life checks at receipt and issue, recurring inspection, and automated identification and scrapping of expired lots under a three\-year shelf\-life rule.Batch genealogy and end\-to\-end traceability across goods movements via the Batch Information Cockpit and Global Batch Traceability, including recall scoping to specific deliveries and customers.


**Required Qualifications**

8\+ years SAP consulting with 5\+ full\-lifecycle implementations and hands\-on configuration responsibility for IM and WM; at least 2 on S/4HANA (1909 or later).Deep IM configuration expertise: movement types, special stocks, stock\-status handling, transfer postings, physical inventory and goods\-movement design.Deep WM configuration expertise (or EWM with clear WM equivalency): storage structure, putaway and picking strategies, transfer requirements and orders.Demonstrable FIFO picking, shelf\-life management and batch\-determination delivery in a live production environment.Packing and shipping design with product\-specific packing rules and handling\-unit management.Mobile/RF and hand\-held terminal transactions, barcode/QR scanning and label printing; integration of S/4HANA inventory with an MES or shop\-floor execution layer.Ability to run fit/gap workshops with warehouse and production supervisors and produce auditable functional specifications and test scripts.


**Preferred Qualifications**

Bilingual English/Japanese (business level); prior delivery in Japan or with Japanese manufacturing clients.SAP EWM in addition to WM, with the judgment to advise on WM\-versus\-EWM positioning.SAP Digital Manufacturing inventory and component\-consumption integration experience.Experience replacing a legacy shop\-floor inventor…
